Variants.Content: Entry The towns of Westeros were populated by markets, ports, mills, workshops, bridges, and city gates. Merchants, shipowners, blacksmiths, bakers, and other craftsmen maintained their businesses through guilds, kinships, and hired workers; lords maintained their businesses through stall fees, bridge taxes, and port duties Towns were not completely independent like modern autonomous cities. They were still bound by the power of their lords and royal families, but they could influence politics far beyond their own area with goods, news, and money.
